ACME TECHNOLOGIES PRIVATE LIMITED - Letter templates

Sample letter in each look. Click to open full size (with the Print / Save as PDF button). Default: classic. Use one with --template <id>.

Boxed (boxed)

Formal framed header (logo, registration numbers, contact box) and a framed signature box. For official letters, undertakings and declarations where a traditional boxed look is wanted.

A4A5

Classic (classic)

No boxes or frames. A thin double rule under the header, a hairline footer rule and a single rule above the signature, all in the company's accent colour. Default for formal business letters.

A4A5

Modern (modern)

Open header with a thick accent-colour rule top and bottom and a minimal signature block. Good for proposals, quotations and business correspondence.

A4A5

Plain (black and white) (plain)

Black-and-white letterhead with the full header and footer, as a photocopy or scan of the printed letterhead would look. No colour anywhere; logo, seal and stamp are forced to black and white. Good for photocopying, faxing and mono printers.

A4A5

Stationery (pre-printed paper) (stationery)

No header or footer, just generous top and bottom space. Use when printing on pre-printed company letterhead paper.

A4A5
